title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer
description:
Role: Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer Location: India - Remote Work Timings: 2.00 - 11.00 pm IST 
 
 We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AMPscript, CloudPages, SQL, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting personalized marketing communications, landing pages, data-driven campaigns, and automated customer journeys within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role requires strong technical development skills as well as the ability to translate business and marketing requirements into scalable SFMC solutions. 
 Experience: 8+ years of Salesforce Marketing Cloud development experience preferred. 6+ years of hands-on AMPscript development experience. Demonstrated experience designing and developing CloudPages and custom landing-page solutions. Experience supporting production marketing campaigns, automated journeys, and enterprise-scale customer communications. 
 Key Skills: Salesforce Marketing Cloud | AMPscript | CloudPages | SQL | SSJS | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Journey Builder | Automation Studio | Content Builder | Contact Builder | Data Extensions | REST API | SOAP API | Marketing Cloud Connect 
 Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Develop personalized and dynamic email content using AMPscript. Build and maintain CloudPages, landing pages, microsites, forms, preference centers, and subscription-management pages. Develop server-side functionality on CloudPages using AMPscript and Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) where applicable. Create dynamic forms and landing pages that read from and write data to Data Extensions. Implement form submission, validation, data capture, confirmation pages, and error-handling logic. Develop secure and personalized CloudPages using URL parameters, encrypted query strings, subscriber attributes, and Data Extension lookups. Build reusable AMPscript components for personalization, conditional content, data retrieval, data updates, and campaign logic. Develop complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, campaign targeting, reporting, and data transformation. Design and manage Data Extensions, subscriber data, Contact Builder relationships, and SFMC data architecture. Develop and maintain automated processes using Automation Studio, including SQL Query Activities, imports, extracts, file transfers, and scheduled workflows. Build and support customer journeys using Journey Builder, including entry events, decision splits, personalization, triggered communications, and journey data. Develop responsive HTML email templates and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with Salesforce CRM and other enterprise platforms using Marketing Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, SFTP, and other integration mechanisms. Troubleshoot AMPscript, CloudPages, automations, journeys, email rendering, and data-related issues. Perform unit testing, code reviews, deployment validation, and production support. Develop reusable technical components and follow development standards for security, maintainability, performance, and scalability. Maintain technical documentation for CloudPages, data models, APIs, automations, journeys, and integrations. Work closely with marketing, business, technology, and data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions. 
 Required Qualifications: Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC). Strong proficiency in AMPscript, including: Personalization Conditional logic Lookup functions Data Extension reads and updates Subscriber and contact attributes String, date, and formatting functions Redirects and URL handling Error handling Dynamic content Strong hands-on experience developing CloudPages. Experience developing: Landing pages Lead capture forms Registration forms Preference centers Unsubscribe pages Confirmation and thank-you pages Dynamic personalized pages Experience using AMPscript functions such as Lookup, LookupRows, RetrieveSalesforceObjects, UpsertData, InsertData, UpdateData, RequestParameter, Redirect, CloudPagesURL, and related functions. Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data transformation, and audience management. Hands-on experience with: Content Builder Email Studio Journey Builder Automation Studio Contact Builder Data Extensions Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Understanding of responsive email and web development. Experience integrating SFMC with external systems using REST and/or SOAP APIs. Experience with SFTP-based file integrations and automated data processing. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills. Understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud subscriber, contact, and consent-management concepts. 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Experience with CloudPages security and secure data handling. Experience implementing encrypted and personalized URLs using CloudPagesURL. Experience working with Salesforce CRM through Marketing Cloud Connect. Familiarity with JSON and API-based integrations. Experience building custom preference centers and consent-management solutions. Knowledge of email deliverability and subscriber-management best practices. Understanding of CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and related data-privacy requirements. Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementations. Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are preferred.

title: Seo Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist 
 Job Summary We are looking for a results-driven SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to strengthen our online presence, increase website traffic, generate qualified leads, and improve search engine rankings. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SEO, content marketing, paid advertising, social media marketing, and web analytics, with a strong understanding of the latest digital marketing trends and search engine algorithms. 
 Key Responsibilities Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Develop and execute comprehensive on-page and off-page SEO strategies. Perform keyword research and competitor analysis. Optimize website content, metadata, internal linking, and technical SEO elements. Monitor website performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Build high-quality backlinks through ethical link-building techniques. Conduct regular SEO audits and implement recommendations. Stay updated with Google algorithm updates and industry best practices. Content Marketing Plan and manage SEO-focused content strategies. Optimize blogs, landing pages, and service pages for search engines. Ensure content aligns with user intent and business objectives. Digital Marketing Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels. Manage Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, and other paid campaigns. Optimize campaign performance to improve ROI and reduce acquisition costs. Execute email marketing and remarketing campaigns. Social Media Marketing Create and manage content calendars. Grow brand awareness through organic and paid social media campaigns. Monitor engagement and analyze campaign performance. Analytics & Reporting Track website performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools. Prepare monthly reports on traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance. Provide actionable insights to improve the effectiveness of digital marketing. Website & Conversion Optimization Collaborate with developers to improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, and technical SEO. Optimize landing pages for higher conversion rates. Conduct A/B testing and recommend UX improvements. 
 Required Skills Strong knowledge of On-Page, Off-Page, and Technical SEO. Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console. Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. Knowledge of keyword research tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Ubersuggest. Understanding of HTML, CSS, and website structure is an advantage. Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms. Knowledge of backlink analysis and outreach strategies. Familiarity with local SEO and international SEO. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field. Google Ads Certification or Google Analytics Certification is preferred. Digital marketing certifications are an added advantage. 
 Experience 3-6 years of experience in SEO and Digital Marketing. Experience working with IT services, SaaS, software products, or digital agencies will be preferred. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Growth in organic website traffic. Improvement in keyword rankings. Increase in qualified leads generated. Growth in website conversion rate. Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Cost per Lead (CPL). Organic backlinks acquired. Improvement in domain authority and website health score. Social media engagement and follower growth.

Key Skills: Social media,Link building,Engine,Searching,Search engine optimization,Research,Building,Hootsuite
